task.title: Fix review: test quality of the F-001..F-013 regression suite
task.description: Judge whether the tests added by T33, T34, T35, T36 and T39 genuinely constrain the fixed behaviour, or whether any of them can pass vacuously.
task.scope: Read-only review of the new and changed test files across apps/cli, apps/relay and packages.

acceptance_criteria: Every new test file added in this fix wave is assessed for whether it would still fail if its fix were reverted - not merely whether it passes today.

The two deterministic hooks that closed the previously unverifiable findings are scrutinised: the F-003 persistence fault (a second node:sqlite connection holding BEGIN IMMEDIATE against the same profile database with busy_timeout=0) and the F-008 concurrency barrier (test-only instrumentation on EncryptedSqliteStore.prototype.transaction, anchored to the stale outbox read). State whether each is anchored to the semantic event or to an implementation detail that a future refactor would silently break.

The deliberately-green guard tests are assessed for whether they actually constrain the fix: the F-009 single-maximum-size-envelope guard, the F-003 exit-3 control, the six F-013 invalid-input guards, and the F-005 server-cap subtest.
The F-012 mutation evidence is assessed, including the control showing the ORIGINAL test survived the same mutation.
Any test that is over-fitted to the current implementation, asserts on incidental values, or would pass vacuously is reported as a finding with its file and test name.
Confirm no pre-existing test was weakened, skipped or deleted, independently of the orchestrator's mtime checks and T37's hash verification.
constraints: Read /Users/Goodea/goodea/projects/echolet/.metaproject/index.md before any repository action; project root is /Users/Goodea/goodea/projects/echolet.

Read .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/reviews/2026-09-06-fixreview-echolet-cli-prototype-t38/inputs/review-context.md FIRST for the disposition vocabulary and the five non-negotiable criteria.

You are a reviewer. Do NOT modify any source or test file permanently. A bounded mutation pass is allowed ONLY to answer 'would this test still fail if the fix were reverted', and every mutation MUST be reverted, with the file verified byte-identical afterwards. Report exactly which mutations you ran.
Do not re-run the full verification matrix; T37 already did and passed.
Do not edit flow.json or acceptance-criteria.md.
Use `keryx ctx rg` for searches, never bare rg/grep. Use `keryx ctx run` for long command output.
Never print plaintext message bodies, ciphertext, profile store keys, private key material or HTTP request bodies.
Do not commit and do not create a branch, PR or remote.
Respect prototype scope: do not demand production-grade test infrastructure, CI, or coverage thresholds that this prototype never claimed.

Write a valid subagent-result to .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/reviews/2026-09-06-fixreview-echolet-cli-prototype-t38/review-testing-practices-result.json and a report to .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/reviews/2026-09-06-fixreview-echolet-cli-prototype-t38/review-testing-practices-report.md, and make the final response start with STATUS:.
